function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is an empty array

**C♯ Major Scale**

| Degree | Note | Enharmonic Equivalent |
|--------|------|-----------------------|
| 1 (Tonic) | C♯ | – |
| 2 | D♯ | – |
| 3 | E♯ | **F** |
| 4 | F♯ | – |
| 5 | G♯ | – |
| 6 | A♯ | **B♭** |
| 7 | B♯ | **C** |
| 8 (Octave) | C♯ | – |

**Intervals (whole‑step / half‑step)**  
Whole – Whole – Half – Whole – Whole – Whole – Half  

**Key Signature**  
Seven sharps: F♯, C♯, G♯, D♯, A♯, E♯, B♯

**Relative Minor**  
A♯ minor (the key of A♯ minor shares the same key signature)

**Circle of Fifths Position**  
C♯ major is one step clockwise from B major (which has five sharps) and one step counter‑clockwise from D♭ major (which has five flats).

---

### Quick Reference

- **Scale Notes**: C♯, D♯, E♯, F♯, G♯, A♯, B♯, C♯  
- **Intervals**: W–W–H–W–W–W–H  
- **Key Signature**: 7 sharps  
- **Relative Minor**: A♯ minor
